sandbachFocus: Sandbach United face New Mills at home on Saturday 15 August at 15:00, looking to build on their recent 1-0 victory over Stafford Town. Both teams currently sit on 6 points, making this a crucial clash between two sides with identical records so far this season. The Bach will be seeking a second consecutive home win after their midweek triumph.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals remain unbeaten at the summit with 9 points from 3 games, hosting Widnes Town in what should be a comfortable fixture for the league leaders. AFC Bridgnorth (6pts, 2 games) face Crewe away, while fellow title contenders Eccleshall (6pts, 3 games) travel to Foley Meir. Stafford Town, after their loss to Sandbach, host Crewe in an important rematch of sorts. The bottom end sees struggles persist: Market Drayton Town (0pts) visit Wolverhampton Casuals away, while Alsager Town, Allscott Heath, and Widnes Town all sit on minimal points and face uphill battles. Brereton Social (6pts, 2 games) face Bilston Town, offering another opportunity for the unbeaten teams to cement early season momentum.
